verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents direct access to search and retrieve documentation content, confirmed by a probe of the documented page. However, this appears limited to docs search/retrieval rather than a full agentic interface to MoonPay's payment/on-ramp APIs. Missing for 10: evidence of MCP server enabling agents to actually invoke MoonPay transactional functionality (quotes, sessions, buy/sell), independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP server working in practice.
